A '''family''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dodz]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. The family was largely [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Kugg]], save for [[Jost Ellon]], who proved instrumental in the dictator's overthrow.
